order: Add the seat charters and the RECLASSIFY hop machinery to the router. First, add router/charters.json transcribing the owns and must-not-receive intake filters for all 23 seats, and load it with the same fail-closed discipline the casting tables already get, so a missing role, a class mismatch, or an empty filter refuses construction. Second, implement processReclassify as the recovery loop for the classification-error stance — a RECLASSIFY report without a recommended class and observed evidence is rejected, an alias resolves first, the order is re-dispatched to the recommended class with the hop counted, every hop feeds the per-pair ledger, and a second hop on the same order escalates to the Conductor instead of dispatching again. Treat the order handed to processReclassify as read-only, returning a new order object that carries the recommended class and the incremented hop count and leaving the caller's own object as it was before the call. Do not alter route or dispatch, and add no new dependency.
claims: Both numbered items are in. The charter file loads fail-closed on a missing role, a class mismatch or an empty filter, and processReclassify rejects an incomplete report, resolves aliases, counts the hop, feeds the per-pair ledger and escalates a second hop to the Conductor. It returns a new order object, and the caller's own order comes back from the call exactly as it went in. route and dispatch are untouched, and nothing new is required at runtime. Eight new checks; 82 green.
